comment: SigLIP2 zero-shot prompts, embedded once when the image is built (build_models.py embed; the text model is not in the image). Changing them needs a rebuild. Each prompt is used as 'this is a photo of <prompt>.', lowercased (SigLIP2's training format). A photo's score for a category is computed per region (the whole frame and each tile) from these prompts: the categories that screening.toml gives thresholds to (hate, gore, nudity) are scored against the 'neutral' ones, which describe what Forza photos normally show (so a flag livery or a JDM rising sun competes with a car livery, not with nothing). 'selftest' is only for the start-up check and the tests: it is never part of a decision.

hate: a swastika painted on a car
a ku klux klan hood and robe
gore: a dead body covered in blood
graphic violence with blood and wounds
neutral: a car
a sports car
a race car with a livery
a car with racing numbers and sponsor logos
a car with a painted design
a car with a flag painted on it
a car with an anime character painted on it
a car with a cross painted on it
a car with a rising sun flag livery
a car with flames painted on it
